${lajsvaTurningPoints.map((row) => `### ${row.timestamp_epoch} · ${row.leg_id}

"UNKNOWN"}/${row.derivation.depth_distribution_cents.q50 ?? "UNKNOWN"}/${row.derivation.depth_distribution_cents.q75 ?? "UNKNOWN"}; chosen depth ${row.derivation.chosen_depth_cents ?? "UNKNOWN"}; window ${JSON.stringify(row.derivation.window_timing)}; pair state ${row.derivation.pair_state}; allocation ${JSON.stringify(row.derivation.allocation)}.

Sentence verbatim:

\`\`\`text
${row.sentence}
\`\`\``).join("

")}

## 4. Actions with reasons

${processReceipt.actions_with_reasons.map((row) => `- ${row.event_id}|${row.leg_id} @ ${row.timestamp_epoch}: lineage context ${row.lineage_target_cents ?? "NONE"}; composition ${row.composition_action.action} ${row.composition_action.target_cents ?? "NONE"}; reason ${row.composition_reason}; allocation ${row.allocation?.mode ?? "NONE"}.`).join("
")}

## 5. Fills as consequences

${fillEvents.length ? fillEvents.map((row) => `- ${row.context.event_id}|${row.context.leg_id}: ${row.context.entry_cents}¢ at ${row.context.fill_timestamp_epoch}, receipt ${row.row_refs.join(",")}.`).join("
") : "- None."}

## 6. Four-game deltas and gate verdict

${storyResults.map((row) => `- ${row.event_id}: ${row.composition_rebuild.completed ? `${row.composition_rebuild.combined_entry_cents}¢, Δ${row.composition_rebuild.delta_vs_100_cents}` : "PARTIAL"}.`).join("
")}

Gate: ${floorBreaks.length === 0 && lawViolations.length === 0 ? "PASS" : `SELF-STOP (${floorBreaks.length ? "ratchet break" : "law violation"})`}.
`;
